justification: Critical: changes who 554 served Inner West LEP rules are shown to (57 narrowed), adds a tagger path, and publishes Inner West in the outreach scoped-council list.

pre_impl.existing_data: DQ-140 read 1,108: all 554 served Inner West LEP 2022 rows had zone and dev-type scope from no_config or never tagged; no row carried its clause (332 had provision_N refs, all section_header NULL).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Scope configs are per DCP chapter and matched by document_id; an LEP states its reach per clause, and its rows are split by subclause, so the row text alone carries no scope.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses _from_entry/_resolve and the retag script's backup and narrowing guard; adds one config keyed by clause and a clause argument to tag_with_provenance.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Clause placement and every scope quote come from the in-force Plan on legislation.nsw.gov.au (fetched via the Fly monitor IP, 2026-10-10); each quote was checked to occur verbatim before the config was written.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No type change: v2_applicable_zones / v2_applicable_dev_types keep their array shape; section_header gains clause headings the LEP pages already render.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Without this, every Inner West LEP rule reaches every property and project because nobody decided its scope; with a wrong narrowing a rule would be hidden, so only zones/types the clause names narrow it.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_inner_west_lep_scope.py -q ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-140 ; python scripts/outreach_scoped_councils.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: An Inner West LEP row falls back to text regex or no_config with a clause entry present, a declared scope lacks its quote, or the published council list stops matching.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: the first clause placement matched 0 of 554 rows because the Plan fetch had timed out; re-fetched, 534 placed by text and 21 by reading. Readers proposed category-based zone lists (6.3) and a partial dev list (6.10); both were overruled to declined. After the retag OC-17 failed because Inner West now passes but was unpublished; the list was updated. DQ-140 1,108 -> 0.

functions.name: _get_inner_west_lep_config
functions.input: a provision's document_id and the clause heading taken from its section_header column
functions.output: a config result with zones, dev types and their provenance for that clause, or None for non Inner West LEP documents
functions.if_none: An Inner West LEP row whose clause has no entry gets a no_config result, never a text-regex guess.

functions.name: clause_key
functions.input: a section_header string such as '6.34 Development of ...' or 'Land Use Table Zone R1 ...'
functions.if_none: Returns None for an empty or unrecognised heading, so the row is no_config.

values.source: Inner West LEP 2022 in-force text, quoted per entry
values.read_at: applicability tagger via the retag script
values.if_missing: no_config: the rule stays served to all, flagged undecided by DQ-140.

queries.where_clause: id = v.id AND section_header IS NULL AND source_council = 'inner_west'

break_it.scenario: A clause names zones only by category ('residential zones') and a reader converts it to codes
break_it.what_happens: Overruled to declined: the rule stays shown to all zones with the quote recorded
break_it.how: main-session rule: lists only where the clause names the codes

break_it.scenario: A row's text names a zone but its clause has no entry in the config
break_it.what_happens: no_config, not a regex narrowing that could hide the rule
break_it.how: the LEP path returns a config result even when empty

break_it.scenario: A DCP document passes a clause argument to the tagger by mistake
break_it.what_happens: Ignored: only Inner West LEP document ids take the clause path

break_it.scenario: A declared clause scope has no quote from the Plan behind it
break_it.what_happens: The test fails and names the clause and field

break_it.scenario: Inner West passes its checks but the public council list still omits it
break_it.what_happens: OC-17 fails until the list names it; it now does

break_it.scenario: The rows to retag include unserved or retired Inner West rows that must not change what is shown
break_it.what_happens: They are retagged too, but only served rows reach a property; the dry run listed served narrowings separately (57) and the apply refused any other count
break_it.how: --expect-narrowings 57 guard on served rows, backup table, per-row concurrency guard

break_it.scenario: A retag backup table is created in the public schema with default grants
break_it.what_happens: The public browser key could write to it; the script now revokes those grants and enables row-level security straight after creating it
break_it.how: REVOKE ALL FROM anon, authenticated + ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; DQ-138 back to 0

post_merge.manual_verify: Applied 2026-10-10: migration 102 and the retag (backup table regulatory_provisions_dq140_backup_20261010). python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-140 reads 0.
